title: Deployable VPC Blueprint + Upgrade Sentinel for Private Deployments
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a reusable, production-ready Terraform module and operational pattern for VPC networking that supports safe rolling upgrades, automated health probes, and routing reconciliation for Private (VPC) deployments. The module should define subnets (control/data), dual-mode egress (IGW + NAT gateway patterns), granular VPC endpoints, route tables per-subnet, and hooks for automated upgrade sentinel checks.
background: We currently have several ad-hoc VPC IaC patterns used across customers and partners. Upgrades (provider, module changes, or route edits) have led to transient egress failures and endpoint drift during canary rollouts. This ticket formalizes a deployable blueprint plus an upgrade sentinel that validates networking invariants before and after terraform apply to reduce incidents during private/on-prem upgrades.
goals: 1) Deliver a single Terraform module that codifies recommended subnet role patterns (control, compute, storage), per-subnet route tables, and endpoint attachments. 2) Provide an upgrade sentinel process that runs pre/post checks (synthetic egress probes, endpoint reachability, route reconciliation) and can block or auto-rollback terraform changes when critical invariants fail. 3) Integrate module outputs with existing deployment automation (bootstrap scripts + operator runbooks).
approach:
- Design HCL module with opinionated defaults but easy overrides (CIDR sizing, AZ spread, NAT strategy).
- Implement optional 'egress-mode' variable: "split-nat" (private subnets to NAT), "igw-first" (public subnets via IGW fallback), and "explicit" (customers opt routes).
- Expose outputs for route_table_ids, nat_gateway_ids, endpoint_ids, and subnet_tags to be consumed by the platform operator.
- Supply a small test harness (bash + terraform + a lightweight probe container) used by CI and operator runbooks to exercise the sentinel checks.
- Add lifecycle hooks (pre-plan validation, plan-time invariants, post-apply sentinel) integrated as a Makefile/CI step and as a terraform null_resource with local-exec for operator-invoked runs.
terraform_interface: Module inputs (strings): vpc_id, az_list (list), cidr_block, subnet_roles (map), egress_mode, enable_endpoints (bool), endpoint_services (list), tags (map). Module outputs (strings/list): public_subnet_ids, private_subnet_ids, route_table_ids, nat_gateway_ips, interface_endpoint_ids. NOTE: For this ticket we will provide JSON-serializable output strings only; platform consumers will parse them in the deployment orchestration layer.
upgrade_strategy:
1) Plan-time invariant checks: compare current deployed state (via data sources) to desired changes; if delete/replace of NAT or route_table is detected, mark plan as 'high-risk' and require canary approval.
2) Canary apply: allow apply to target a single AZ or subset of subnets; sentinel runs synthetic checks before marking canary successful.
3) Roll-forward policy: on canary success, proceed to remaining AZs; on failure, automatically revert by applying prior saved plan/state or collision-rescue workflow.
4) Drift-safe replacements: create replacements (new resource) before deleting old resource where possible (eg create new NAT in new AZ then switch routes).
health_checks:
- Synthetic egress probe container that attempts DNS + external HTTP(S) calls using private IP path and via endpoint services.
- VPC Endpoint reachability: validate interface endpoints respond on expected ports and certificate subjects where applicable.
- Route reconciliation: assert each private subnet's route table has a default route pointing to expected gateway id (nat or igw) and no unexpected 0.0.0.0/0 routes.
- Endpoint drift detector: compare terraform-managed endpoint list to AWS API response; raise alert if unknown endpoints exist.
- Periodic probe: run lightweight probes every 5 minutes for 1 hour after upgrades; failure threshold triggers auto rollback or operator paging depending on severity.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Infra dev): module + tests implemented and reviewed (target: 2 weeks). Phase 2 (Internal Canary): deploy to internal lab VPC, exercise canary upgrade and sentinel (1 week). Phase 3 (Partner Pilot): enable for one customer private deployment with operator supervision (2 weeks). Phase 4 (GA): flip default for new private clusters and publish runbook and code examples (2 weeks).
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module exposes documented inputs/outputs and includes examples for single/multi-AZ private VPCs.
Pre-plan invariant checks surface high-risk changes in CI and require explicit approval when detected.
Upgrade sentinel runbook executes pre/post checks and will block rollouts when critical probes fail.
Automated canary patching demonstrates successful create-new-then-swap pattern for NAT replacement in lab environment.
Health check probe failures result in documented rollback or escalation path; alerts emitted to oncall channel.
Security review completed and KMS/HSM integration validated for endpoint-related secrets where applicable.
tasks: Design Terraform HCL module and variable schema
Implement core resources: subnets, route tables, nat gateways, igw, interface/gateway endpoints
Add outputs and tagging conventions for operator consumption
Develop pre-plan invariant checker script (CI hook)
Create sentinel probe container and CI job to run synthetic tests
Write canary apply orchestration & rollback script
Author operator runbook and postmortem checklist
Security review & threat model for endpoint exposure
Integration tests in lab environment and runbook rehearsal

open_issues:
- Need to validate state migration strategy for existing customers using older modules.
- Edge case: provider drift when AZ names differ across accounts (requires mapping layer).
- Cost estimate for multi-AZ NAT footprints needs finance approval.
notes: Priority is resiliency and predictable upgrades for Private deployments. Keep defaults conservative (safer) and document cost tradeoffs. Ensure runbook is operator-friendly and that CI flags are actionable. Coordinate with Platform QA to run upgrade drills before partner pilot.
